image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a large common iguana resting in grassy vegetation. The image focuses on the mid-section and hindquarters of the lizard, showing its textured greyish-green scales, a prominent dorsal crest of spines running along the back, and a large circular subtympanic shield near the jaw/neck area. The head is partially visible on the left, but the face details are cut off or out of focus. The tail extends towards the right, blending into the background foliage.
